description: The interface table HZ_IMP_FINREPORTS_T stores information for population into HZ_FINANCIAL_REPORTS table.

columns.name: FINREPORT_T_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_IMP_FINREPORTS_T interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: INTERFACE_ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the HZ_IMP_FINREPORTS_T interface record. Internal use only.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for a Batch

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description: Original System ID for the Party

columns.name: PARTY_ORIG_SYSTEM_REFERENCE
columns.description: Original System Reference for the Party

columns.name: FINREPORT_ORIG_SYSTEM
columns.description:
Original System ID for the Financial 
Report

columns.name: FINREPORT_ORIG_SYSTEM_REF
columns.description:
Original System Reference for 
the Financial Report

columns.name: FINANCIAL_REPORT_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier of the Financial Report

columns.name: TYPE_OF_FINANCIAL_REPORT
columns.description: A name for the financial report. For example, 10K report, Annual Report, Shareholder's Special Report.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_REFERENCE
columns.description: Any specific reference name or number. For example, a library identifier or publisher's identifier (ISBN) that uniquely identifies the document or publication

columns.name: DATE_REPORT_ISSUED
columns.description: The publication date of a financial report

columns.name: ISSUED_PERIOD
columns.description: The period covered by the financial report. For example, fiscal year 1999, 1Q98, and so on.

columns.name: REPORT_START_DATE
columns.description: May use report start and end dates instead of ISSUED_PERIOD

columns.name: REPORT_END_DATE
columns.description: May use report start and end dates instead of ISSUED_PERIOD

columns.name: INSERT_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if a record should be explicitly inserted or updated

columns.name: ACTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates the action of insert or update based on matching outcome.

columns.name: PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party that owns the financial report

columns.name: AUDIT_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports are audited. Y for audited, N for unaudited.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports are consolidated. Y for consolidated, N for unconsolidated

columns.name: ESTIMATED_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports provide estimated data. Y for estimated, N for actual or measured data.

columns.name: FINAL_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports are the final closing statements for a business that has ceased operations. Y for final closing statements, N for normal operations.

columns.name: FISCAL_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports cover a fiscal twelve-month accounting period. Y for a twelve-month fiscal period, N for anything other than a twelve-month fiscal period.

columns.name: FORECAST_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports display forecasts or future projections. Y for forecast data, N for historical data

columns.name: OPENING_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports are the opening statements for a business. Y for opening statements, N for normal operations

columns.name: PROFORMA_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports are pro forma numbers. Y for pro forma numbers, N for normal numbers

columns.name: QUALIFIED_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports include qualifying remarks from auditors about the fairness and accuracy of the numbers. Y for reports qualified by auditors, N for reports that were not qualified.

columns.name: REQUIRING_AUTHORITY
columns.description: Name of the primary organization that requires this financial report. For example, auditors, the Federal Trade Commission, and the Internal Revenue Service.

columns.name: RESTATED_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports include data that was corrected after the original financial reports. Y for restated, N for the original numbers.

columns.name: SIGNED_BY_PRINCIPALS_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports were signed by the principals of the organization. Y for signed reports, N for unsigned reports.

columns.name: TRIAL_BALANCE_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports include trial balance numbers. Y for trial balance numbers, N for normal numbers.

columns.name: UNBALANCED_IND
columns.description: Indicates if the financial reports include balance sheet accounts that do not balance. Y for reports that include unbalanced balance sheet accounts. N for reports that only include balanced accounts.

columns.name: INTERFACE_STATUS
columns.description: Status for the data in the interface table

columns.description: Foreign Key to the Error Table
